issue_request: Published/Persuasive BR&R change request to add SubstanceDefinition.manufacturer as a Reference(Organization) for detailed substance manufacturer information; a pre-vote Jira comment expanded the same tracker context to add SubstanceDefinition.supplier similarly, requested by FDA. Later related audits FHIR-31826 and FHIR-31827 on the combined branch clarify manufacturer cardinality/meaning and manufacturer-vs-supplier definitions without reversing the FHIR-25054 additions. BR&R minutes corroborate the approval, and community searches found no conflicting guidance.
